methodology.requests: GET only, no cache busting, purge or writes; at most one request per wiki at a time.
methodology.samples: Three repeated full-page requests after section discovery and probe; no forced cold-cache run.
methodology.sizes: HTTP body bytes observed with explicit gzip negotiation, excluding headers and TLS overhead.
methodology.projection: Identical local JSON encoder and gzip level 6 for full and fragment responses; not a deployed endpoint.
methodology.timing: Network totals include proxy, connection, TLS, wiki and transfer. No server CPU or parser-cache hit ratio is inferred.
methodology.cache: HTTP cache headers are not parser-cache evidence. Parser-cache eligibility is checked separately in MediaWiki source.
methodology.extractor: The actual modules/reading/core.js function, executed by Node; 21 local extraction samples per response.
methodology.privacy: Only public metadata, sizes, hashes and timings saved. No secret values or downloaded HTML saved.
